$comment: Garden theme board. Sizes in cells (1 cell = 56 px on the asset sheet), the same units as data/parts.json. Overview: design/themes/garden-board.md. Underlay and the grass bed between the tiles. Reference: 01-board-full. Owner: the rim session; the grass bed (bedRepeat, bedTone, bed.webp) is the bed session's.

underlay.$comment: lip: the plate stops this far inside the rim's outside, under the braid (the rim picture's far side is thinner than its near side). cornerRadius: the plate's corners, round enough to stay under the rim picture's round corners. The bed's top is assets/turnflock/garden/board/bed/bed.webp (built by build-bed.py there, in the colours of 01-board-full; design/themes/garden-board-bed.md), repeating every bedRepeat cells (keep equal to REPEAT in build-bed.py), on a matte Lambert material brightened by bedTone so it sits with the tiles as in the picture.
